events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Jiggle Jiggle (Josh Thomas)
events.description: Josh Thomas makes his return to Brisbane Comedy Festival with his quirky, hilarious, and authentic new show Jiggle Jiggle, a headline act of the festival's final week.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Okay, I Believe You
events.description: An Auslan-interpreted comedy show running as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival, offering an accessible, inclusive, and community-focused experience at Brisbane Powerhouse.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Shad & Pete Save the World!
events.description: A late-night raw variety comedy show, part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival, offering an intimate, irreverent, and unpredictable experimental performance.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Bron Lewis
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse – Underground Theatre, New Farm
events.description: Comedian Bron Lewis shares hilarious stories from her chaotic life, juggling three kids, a new puppy, and a flourishing comedy career, in this stand-up show.

events.title: QSO Italian Gala
events.description: Experience the passion and drama of Italy as the Queensland Symphony Orchestra, led by Maestro Umberto Clerici, presents works from Rossini, Puccini, Verdi, and Vivaldi's Triple Concerto.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series Preview Concerts
events.datetime: Wed 13 May, 7:00 PM & Thu 14 May, 7:00 PM
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra performs Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2, Shostakovich's 5th Symphony, and Cathy Milliken's 'Catalogue of Sky' in these two preview performances.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series: Rachmaninov & Shostakovich (Main Night)
events.description: The headline Maestro Series concert features Rachmaninov's beloved Piano Concerto No. 2 alongside Shostakovich's emotional 5th Symphony, performed by the Queensland Symphony Orchestra.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: GOMA opens late for a multi-sensory art experience with Olafur Eliasson's 'Presence,' featuring bespoke bars, local DJs at the Vinyl Listening Bar, and live performances for a unique night of art, music, and connection.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Exclusive to Brisbane, this major exhibition by contemporary artist Olafur Eliasson features large-scale works playing with light, colour, and perception, offering an immersive experience as visitors move through it.

events.title: GOMA Kids Tour: Presence & Play
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: These multi-sensory tours of 'Olafur Eliasson: Presence' are designed for families, guiding children through playful experiences to explore art, spark imagination, and build connection in a crowd-free setting.

events.title: Australian Cinémathèque: Double Take (Ongoing Film Program)
events.location: Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
events.description: GOMA's dedicated cinema space presents 'Double Take,' an ongoing program of curated international and art house films, offering a rare opportunity for thoughtful film culture.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Permanent & Current Exhibitions
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Explore ongoing exhibitions at the Museum of Brisbane in City Hall, covering local history and culture, offering an intellectually engaging and culturally rich experience with free entry.

events.title: Dearly Departed: Death in Life — SLQ Exhibition
events.location: State Library of Queensland (SLQ), South Brisbane
events.description: A thought-provoking exhibition at the State Library of Queensland engaging with themes of death, dying, memory, and remembrance, featuring tarot cards as visual stories of change and transformation.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.description: Hosted by Ranger Stacey, this free community event features a wide range of outdoor activities, sports demonstrations, interactive displays, and nature excursions for all ages across Redlands Coast.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — City Walking Tours
events.location: Departing Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Regular guided walking tours from the Museum of Brisbane explore the history, architecture, and hidden stories of Brisbane's CBD, ideal for curious and conversation-loving participants.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Select Sundays Walking Tours
events.location: Departing Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Another opportunity for a guided walking tour by the Museum of Brisbane, exploring the city's history and architecture, designed for engaging social interaction and discovery.
